summary: Tested Market Scan (Simular → Vários pares), the Robô 2 API and screen, log separation, and the mt_bot selector. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (the add/replace test was rerun on its own after the parallel run skipped it). Ran a real stocks/1d scan in ~20s; it found 4 results, all passing the rule and sorted by score. Frontend: mode chips, market/TF chips, the disabled state with no TFs, progress text, row toggle, select-all/clear, add-to-Robô 2 toast, the bot2 screen (risk steppers, remove, save, the enable-with-no-setups error toast, run cycle) and the bot screen MT chips all work. Code review of _run_bot_cycle(bot2) found the MT routing and paper fallback correct, with one gap in how the trial expiry is enforced. No real MT orders were placed. The user's state was restored: main bot paper/main/disabled, Robô 2 disabled, risk 1.0, setups TSLA 1d and MSFT 1d.

minor.issue: The live_until expiry (1-week MT trial, then back to paper) is only checked when not bot2 (server.py:1954), and bot_loop only runs the main cycle for enabled main bots. So when mt_bot=='bot2' and the main bot is disabled, live_mode stays 'metatrader' and Robô 2 keeps sending real MT orders after the trial ends. Fix: run the expiry check for bot2 too (it updates db.bots), or check it in bot_loop for every bot with live_mode metatrader.

Stop/target closes are only logged when source=='bot' (server.py:1069). Robô 2 (source 'bot2') closes by SL/TP write no log, so the Robô 2 Atividade list never shows them. The log should also be written with scope 'bot2' so it does not leak into the main logs.
Uses scope {$ne:'hfx'}, so Robô 2 logs (scope 'bot2') are counted in the main bot's daily summary numbers. Use {$nin:['hfx','bot2']}.
The 429 check (find running job, then insert) is not atomic, so two quick concurrent POSTs can start two scans. Low risk because the UI disables the button.

ui_bugs.issue: router.back() does nothing when /bot2 is opened directly (deep link / web refresh): there is no history, so the user is stuck. Add a fallback: router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/(tabs)/simulate'). Back works fine when coming from Simular.

Local cfg only re-syncs when the server's setups.length changes (line 38-41). When a scan add replaces an existing symbol|tf (same length), the open screen keeps the old params, and 'Guardar' overwrites the new setup with the stale one.

issues: The 'Adicionar ao Robô 2 (N)' label wraps onto 2 lines in its flex:1.4 button at 390px width.

The result row subtitle (styles.note) has paddingHorizontal:16 inside the row, so it is indented 16px from the title. Use a separate style without horizontal padding inside rows (same in bot2 setup rows).
The market/TF chips reset to Forex/1H+4H on reload while the shown results belong to the last job (e.g. Ações 1D). Consider setting cat/tfs from the job.
ChipRow chips are 36px tall, below the 44px touch target (bot-mt-bot-*, scan-cat-*, scan-tfs-*).

action_items: Apply the MT trial expiry (live_until) when Robô 2 is the MT bot, even if the main bot is disabled.
Log Robô 2 SL/TP closes in check_exits with scope 'bot2'.
Exclude scope 'bot2' from the main bot counts in the daily summary.
bot2.tsx: add a fallback for the back button and re-sync setups when their content changes (not just the length).
Minor UI: wrapped scan-add label, subtitle indentation in rows, 36px chips.
critical_code_review_comments: MT routing logic (server.py:1959-1961) is correct. Robô 2 goes to MT only when live_mode=='metatrader' and mt_bot=='bot2'. The main bot falls back to paper when mt_bot=='bot2'. Robô 2 never uses Binance.
Robô 2 positions use source 'bot2', and state/last_bar/last_run go to db.bots2. It shares the paper account and per-user lock with the main bot.
Stale 'running' scan jobs are reset on startup (server.py:3036). Good.
server.py is 3050+ lines and should be split (scan/bot2 into their own module).
seed_data_creation: Ran new stocks/1d scan jobs (latest job id 0071db864fc0). The add tests re-added TSLA/MSFT 1d to Robô 2 (same values) and wrote 'setup(s) adicionados' bot2 logs. Robô 2 risk was restored to 1.0 and enabled=false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use test_iter20_scan_bot2.py. Run it with -n0 (pytest.ini uses xdist, and in parallel test_add_and_replace can see an empty running job and skip). The stocks/1d scan takes ~20s. Never set live_mode metatrader on user_test1. On /bot, wait ~3s after load before tapping the bot-exec-mode chips, or the tap is lost to the cfg init.
